# Spiking_Interconnect_Topology

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-19

## Definition
The graph structure and routing fabric that determines how spike packets are exchanged among neuromorphic cores. Topology directly governs latency, fan-out, and energy cost of spike delivery, making it central to TCC-centric neuromorphic design.
